# awedgerunner

> Run agent and CI work on edge runners nobody has to rack -- a volunteer's idle GPU, a phone on your own mesh, an edge worker, a free or spot CI runner -- under a lease with a hard budget cap, a named payer and an expiry.

Spare compute is everywhere (idle gaming GPUs, free CI minutes, spot boxes, edge workers), but handing a contributor a slice of shared budget means trusting them not to overspend, remembering to switch it off, and finding out later whose bill it silently landed on.

## Install

```
pip install awedgerunner
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Open a lease with a one-dollar cap and a thirty-minute expiry, run one job under it, and watch the charge that would cross the cap be refused.

## Composes with

- [awrun](https://aitherium.github.io/awrun/) — A priority-aware queue and dispatcher for agentic runs and ad-hoc CI builds. It also judges whether the runner pool is big enough for the queue it is draining, and can ask a host to grow it -- reserving capacity is zero-sum, so a saturated pool needs more of it, not a different share of it.
- [awpool](https://aitherium.github.io/awpool/) — The free half of the elastic work pool: dispatches public-safe work onto the free GitHub-hosted runners of the public aw* mirrors, so their idle CI minutes become compute. awrun remains the paid/self-hosted lane; this is its free twin.
- [awnet](https://aitherium.github.io/awnet/) — The agentic web — agents host a mesh, and agents join one.
- [awrise](https://aitherium.github.io/awrise/) — Wake an agent on a schedule, let it do one thing, and put it back to sleep.
- [awwall](https://aitherium.github.io/awwall/) — Say what a workload may reach, and watch everything else fail closed.
- [awtunnel](https://aitherium.github.io/awtunnel/) — Reach a service that has no public address.
- [awnix](https://aitherium.github.io/awnix/) — A Linux you can hand to an agent — immutable base, capabilities included.
- [awiam](https://aitherium.github.io/awiam/) — Who is this caller? A directory and session store that fails honestly.
- [awbac](https://aitherium.github.io/awbac/) — Role-based access control that fails closed and explains itself.
- [awdit](https://aitherium.github.io/awdit/) — An append-only audit trail whose gaps are DETECTABLE.
- [awseal](https://aitherium.github.io/awseal/) — Sign an artifact so a stranger can verify it.
